description.narrative: This action responds to urgent flood impacts in the districts of Mabalane, Mapai, and Massangena in Gaza Province, Mozambique, where pre-existing vulnerabilities have been exacerbated by the disaster. The project will reach 20,300 people through WASH and Protection interventions. WASH activities include distribution of 2,400 hygiene kits, rehabilitation of 20 damaged water points, cleaning and disinfection of 30 flood-contaminated water sources, distribution of 3,000 water purifiers in cholera- and diarrhea-affected areas, strengthening 20 water management committees, promotion of hygiene practices, and integration of Infection Prevention and Control in line with Sphere and WASH Cluster standards. Protection activities focus on strengthening community-based protection systems in displacement sites and affected communities. This includes awareness sessions on protection risks, GBV prevention and response, legalrights, and access to services, including support for replacing lost civil documentation. Service mapping and referrals will be conducted in coordination with authorities and protection partners. Mobile teams will provide psychosocial support and Psychological First Aid, and 750 dignity kits will be distributed to women and girls alongside appropriate communication materials

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
